text:
maria (PM): starting thread for 'Guarded Burst' - compact reserved capacity that guarantees short spike coverage for committed customers. need acceptance criteria, pricing model, and ops guardrails.

noah (Eng): high level +1. two clarifying q's: is burst capacity time-limited per incident or continuous rolling token? and what's expected duration we protect for?

maria (PM): planning rolling token-bucket by tenant: default 20 minutes of equivalent peak capacity, or 8% of committed concurrency, whichever is smaller. protects ~5-20m spikes.

reena (Infra): infra note: can't keep whole GPUs idle for cushion. propose warm micro-lanes + BurstManager service that hands out tokens and pins minimal KV slices when active. soft-evict design to avoid stampedes.

lee (SRE): runbook essentials: deterministic fallback path required (quantized model -> regional spill). require chaos test that fully exhausts burst for each fallback. rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 500ms 5m OR error-rate increase >=1% sustained 5m.

sam (Finance): billing options: include small guard fee in reservation (predictable) or metered minutes when consumed. recommend hybrid: small uplift + metered overage. will simulate.

anya (Legal): SLA needs clear definitions: \"burst exhaustion\", allowed failover behavior, credit calc, opt-in checkbox for cross-region spill. for private deployments ensure no automatic region spill unless customer consents.

noah (Eng): implementation sketch:
- BurstManager: token bookkeeping per-reservation, TTL for tokens, metrics emission
- Routing policy: reserved -> burst -> fallback_variant
- KV pinning API + soft eviction window (e.g., 3m grace)

reena (Infra): metrics required: burst_used_minutes, burst_remaining, burst_failover_count, burst_failover_latency. need per-tenant ingestion path. I'll file INFRA ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-5133 \"per-tenant burst metrics ingestion\" assigned to eng-infra.

lee (SRE): alerts to add: burst_utilization >70% for 30m => notify capacity; >95% => page and recommend outreach. Also alert on abnormal failover spikes.

maria (PM): draft acceptance criteria:
- SLO: under committed baseline + burst, p95 < 160ms, p99 < 320ms
- Failover: when burst exhausted, additional tail-latency <500ms for 99% requests
- Billing: by default small uplift applied; pilot customers can opt into metered overage path
- Observability: per-tenant metrics + Console dashboard + daily digest
- Safety: auto-rollback on triggers listed by SRE

noah (Eng): config example for ops:
```
burst_reserve:
  mode: token | percent
  token_minutes: 20
  percent: 8
  fallback_order: quantized_model, spill_region
  billing: uplift_plus_overage | uplift_only
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_ms: 500
    error_rate_pct: 1
```

reena (Infra): timeline proposal:
- week 0: finalize design + pricing model
- weeks 1-3: eng sprint (BurstManager, routing, metrics)
- week 4: internal canary + chaos testing
- week 5: customer pilot (max 3 customers)
- week 6: GA if pilot green

sam (Finance): agree on pilot cap. will post uplift % and overage unit rate tomorrow. pilots require contract addendum.

anya (Legal): will draft pilot addendum and SLA text; cross-region spill requires explicit opt-in.

lee (SRE): will prepare canary checklist and chaos scenarios. propose internal canary then staged pilot at 1% traffic, ramp to 10% over 48h.

maria (PM): next steps: noah + reena to write short spec for BurstManager by EOD Wed; sam to post pricing simulation; anya to draft SLA clause; lee to post canary plan. scheduling 30m sync Thu AM.

noah (Eng): ack, will post spec to product-docs and link here.

reena (Infra): ack, prototyping soft-eviction and KV pinning.

lee (SRE): ack, will circulate checklist.

maria (PM): thanks team :thumbsup: keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the Guarded Burst launch decisions.
